prompt: A sleek, augmented black cat, its fur a mix of organic and synthetic fibers, with subtle, pulsing blue-green bio-luminescent veins beneath its skin. It wears highly reflective, angular chrome sunglasses that completely obscure its eyes, mirroring the chaotic neon glow of the city. One ear is a polished, metallic prosthetic. The cat is perched precariously on a rain-slicked, grimy metallic ledge overlooking a sprawling, dystopian cyberpunk metropolis at night. Towering, monolithic skyscrapers pierce a perpetually overcast, smog-filled sky, adorned with flickering holographic advertisements and tangled conduits. Rain streaks down the buildings, creating shimmering reflections on every surface. Distant flying vehicles cast fleeting shadows. Dominant neon lighting from myriad signs in vibrant purples, electric blues, and fiery oranges casts long, dramatic shadows and specular highlights on the wet surfaces. Strong rim lighting from a giant holographic geisha advertisement behind the cat. Volumetric fog permeates the air, catching the light and creating a hazy, atmospheric glow. Reflective puddles on the ledge mirror the chaotic city lights. Cinematic medium close-up, slightly low-angle shot, positioning the cat in the lower third of the frame, emphasizing its dominance and the vastness of the city below. Leading lines from architectural elements draw the eye towards the cat and into the depth of the city. The cat's fur is meticulously detailed, with individual strands visible, appearing slightly matted from the rain, contrasting with the smooth, polished chrome of its sunglasses and prosthetic. Grime, rust, and water streaks are visible on the metallic ledge and surrounding architecture. The wet asphalt and metal surfaces have a high degree of specularity, creating a glossy, reflective sheen. Shot on an ARRI Alexa LF with an anamorphic lens, giving a wide cinematic aspect ratio. Aperture set to f/1.8 for a very shallow depth of field, with creamy bokeh in the background city lights, making the cat sharply in focus. Subtle lens flare from the brightest neon sources. Film grain (simulated) for a gritty, authentic feel. Color grading emphasizes deep blues, purples, and oranges, with crushed blacks and high contrast, reminiscent of classic sci-fi noir.
